The stomach is located in the upper abdomen, below the esophagus, and is a curved sac-like/J-shaped structure. Reasoning: Observing the leader lines of each label, the leader line of the G label on the right points to this sac-like stomach area located below the esophagus; other nearby labels point to the esophagus, intestines, or other positions of the body. Therefore, the label pointing to stomach is G.
